shortDescription.ru: Тёплая осенняя баллада с акустической гитарой, виолончелью и дуэтом голосов — о светлом принятии увядания.
shortDescription.en: A warm autumn ballad with fingerstyle guitar, cello, and a duet of voices — about gently accepting fading and change.

description.ru:
Осень здесь — не время года, а собеседница. Она приходит в город закрытых окон и уснувших людей, чтобы напомнить им то, что они боятся знать: всё увядает, как листья на закате.

Но говорит она об этом без жестокости — её голос звучит нежно, а дождь на усталых лицах — это не непогода, а слёзы неба, смывающие то, что сами мы смыть не умеем.

Она смеётся и кружится среди людей, идущих слепо мимо, — единственная живая среди спящих. А когда исчезает, так же легко, без прощания, — её смех медленно растворяется в небе.

Потому что уход, случившийся красиво, оставляет после себя не пустоту, а эхо.

Autumn, here, is not a season but a companion. She comes to a city of shuttered windows and sleepwalking people to remind them of the one thing they're afraid to know: everything fades, like leaves at sunset.

But there's no cruelty in how she says it — her voice stays gentle, and the rain on tired faces isn't weather at all, but the sky's own tears, washing away what we never learned to wash away ourselves.

She laughs and spins among the people drifting blindly past — the only living thing in a city of sleepers. And when she vanishes, just as lightly, without a goodbye, her laughter dissolves slowly into the sky.

Because an ending, when it comes gracefully, leaves behind not emptiness, but an echo.

lyrics.ru:
[Verse 1]
Autumn came in soft and slow
Through the city of closed windows
Birds reflected in the glass
Leaves were falling as she passed

[Verse 2]
People walking tired and blind
Through the parks they left behind
Autumn laughed and spun around
Dancing leaves upon the ground

[Chorus]
She said you fade like leaves at sunset
Still believing you will never die
The rain that touched your weary faces
Was only washing tears from the sky

[Verse 3]
Autumn smiled and disappeared
Morning rays and night was clear
Winter whispered through the frost
What was it that autumn lost

[Chorus]
She said you fade like leaves at sunset
Still believing you will never die
The rain that touched your weary faces
Was only washing tears from the sky

[Outro]
And so she left without goodbye
Autumn's laughter filled the sky
